scenes.title:
One angle
isn't enough.
scenes.voice: On a busy production line, a single camera can show only part of the picture.

scenes.title:
The warning
is on the other side.
scenes.voice: The front looks normal. A warning sits on the other side.

scenes.title:
A blocked view.
A missing answer.
scenes.voice: A blocked view creates a different problem: the evidence is missing.

scenes.title:
Two views.
One next step.
scenes.voice: Meet VisualGuard, by YOUNG-FU. Two views. One clear next step for the operator.

scenes.title:
Clear views.
Human review.
scenes.voice: Here is the working application, using paired synthetic images. OpenCV checks image quality and red candidates. Usable views with no red candidates lead to a recommendation for human review.

scenes.title:
A side warning.
Recommend a hold.
scenes.voice: Add a red indicator in the side view. VisualGuard changes the recommendation to hold automation, and shows the visual evidence behind it.

scenes.title:
Missing evidence?
Ask for another view.
scenes.voice: Block the front view, and the result changes to request new images. The system distinguishes an alarm from evidence it cannot use.

scenes.title:
Another view.
Inspect again.
scenes.voice: The operator supplies a new pair. Inspection runs again and returns to review. People stay in charge; this prototype sends no machine commands.

scenes.title: A useful next step.
scenes.voice: The value is a usable next step: review the evidence, recommend a hold, or request another view. Each recommendation includes its supporting trace.

scenes.title:
One vision core.
Local and on AWS.
scenes.voice: The same OpenCV inspection core runs locally and on AWS Lambda. ECR stores the container, and CloudWatch records cloud execution.

scenes.title:
Runs on AWS.
Leaves a trace.
scenes.voice: Four saved AWS calls demonstrate health, alarm, clear, and missing-view behavior. The review viewer opens those records without requiring cloud credentials.

scenes.title: Measure the decisions.
scenes.voice: Across five hundred forty synthetic pairs, exact decision agreement was ninety-four point two six percent. All thirty round red stickers caused false stops.

scenes.title:
The next challenge:
real light.
scenes.voice: Fifteen archived exhibition images produced no red candidates, including a panel with a visible red lamp. Real-image detection remains the next engineering challenge.

scenes.title:
Better evidence.
Human judgment.
scenes.voice: VisualGuard. From two views to an informed next step. Built by YOUNG-FU with OpenCV five and AWS.
